description: Germany only. Checklist of the mandatory written terms of employment under § 2 Abs. 1 NachwG (Nachweisgesetz, Arbeitsvertrag-Check), Germany only. Use it when a founder hires someone or checks a contract: with the start date it gives the deadline for each of the 15 items (first working day, 7th calendar day, one month), with an answer per item it shows what is missing or overdue. It also checks the form: written form, text form since 2025 under conditions, paper-only industries and fixed-term contracts.

angaben.description: What the contract already contains, per item 1 to 15: drin (included), fehlt (missing), entfaellt (not applicable, only for items that apply only if agreed). Items without an answer count as open

beginn.description: Agreed first day of employment; deadlines count from it (YYYY-MM-DD)

empfangsbestaetigung.description: With textform: the employee is asked to confirm receipt

form.description: How the written statement is given: papier (signed paper), textform (PDF or e-mail), nichts (nothing in writing yet)

papierpflicht_branche.description: Industry under § 2a SchwarzArbG (construction, hospitality, passenger transport, logistics, fairground, building cleaning, trade fair construction, meat industry, prostitution, security, hairdressing and cosmetics): paper only, default false

name: nachweis_pflichtangaben
title: Arbeitsvertrag-Check: Pflichtangaben nach NachwG
